title: Xidikians Vanilla Style
description: A really small pack of clientside mods most important a map, for the Xidikian community to use on the vanilla server. Now everybody has the same setup.
body:
This is a really small pack of clientside mods most important a map.  Just a simple collection of QOL mods.

It started as a pack for me to play on my sub server but the community wanted it also, so here it is.



If you want you own server you can get one from Akliz Hosting, the best host I have found !!
